scope: Two sequential red-green slices: navigation experiment admission and normal blocked Task Run outcome.
expected_effect: Reject an unreachable navigation experiment before freezing; return a valid blocked outcome without hiding its evidence or claiming success.
seams: Repository pilot experiment admission and freeze
execute_task_run(OpenTaskRun) through the real product entry
resource_contract: Use existing PatchWorkerConfiguration and one shared repository policy resolver for preflight and runtime. Check read, model-call, observation-byte and wall-time capacity separately; post-trigger reserve is not counted wholly as navigation reads.
verification: Independent red/green evidence per slice, controlled-provider normal-entry composition, Standards and Spec review, then CI. No real model is needed to reproduce either defect.

slice1.initial_red: AttributeError: validate_navigation_experiment absent; exit 1, captured in this session tool output
slice1.entry_red: Explicit resource worker rejected by repository-profile conflict before a run manifest was written; normal OpenTaskRun failed. The conflict was narrowed to preserve rejection of custom evaluators.
intermediate_repairs: Policy resolver default referenced a function-local constant; replaced with the existing policy literal
Controlled-entry expected awaiting_approval; corrected to the existing awaiting_delivery contract
slice1.green: 8 passed; resource admission and eight actual controlled navigations followed by a source read, candidate, check and finish
slice1.model_calls: controlled provider only; zero real model calls

slice2.red: Normal execute_task_run(OpenTaskRun) reproduced DSH_TASK_RUN_OUTCOME_INVALID after one controlled source-read response and a natural model-budget stop.
slice2.green: The same test returns TaskRunCompleted(blocked) with identity, budget, no candidate/check and original evidence references preserved.
slice2.change: Persist and return status in the existing terminal owner; preserve an explicitly supplied status, otherwise use the already determined terminal stage. No new outcome schema or consumer migration.

preserve: all old experiment inputs and results
no replay of 1531, 1552 or the invalid Serilog B0
return_point: After both slices and CI are green, reselect the existing queue and qualify a fresh experiment version before any new real pair. Do not expand restoration architecture or evaluators.
why: 为什么要有它：当前已知失败各用独立反例验证，局部修复必须共同到达正常入口；实验预检与产品结果不能继续靠模型运行排错。
